items.description:
* WHAT...Large breaking waves of 2 to 3 feet above the normal
high tide line.

* IMPACTS...Localized beach erosion may occur.

items.headline: Winter Storm Warning issued October 25 at 11:51AM AKDT until October 26 at 10:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Heavy snow expected. Total snow accumulations between 8 to
16 inches. Winds could gust as high as 35 mph.

* WHERE...South Slopes of the Central Brooks Range.

* WHEN...Until 10 PM AKDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be very difficult.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The snow will come in two waves. There will be
a break with lighter snow Sunday afternoon through Sunday night.
Heavier snow returns Monday morning and continues into the evening
with an additional 4 to 8 inches of snow.
items.areas: South Slopes Of The Central Brooks Range
items.instruction:
If you must travel, keep an extra flashlight, food, and water in your
vehicle in case of an emergency. Visit 511.alaska.gov or call 5 1 1
for the latest road conditions.
